plain_english_policy: This bill restricts candidates running for statewide office in Alabama from lending more than $250,000 of their own money to their campaigns during a single election cycle.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would establish a statutory cap on self-loans by limiting the total amount any candidate can borrow from themselves to $250,000 per election cycle for statewide races. Previously, under existing law as noted in the bill's synopsis, there was no such limit.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Ford advanced this legislation to impose a financial ceiling on personal campaign loans for statewide candidates.
evidence_quotes: "Under exiting law, there is no limit on the amount of funds a candidate seeking election for statewide office may loan his or her campaign."
"This bill would limit the amount of funds a candidate seeking election to a statewide office may loan his or her campaign."
